answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. A ripple of per-task receipts records who did what, and the willow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
